purpose: NPC roadmap pilot selection with provenance, licence and execution gates.

candidates.primitive: Expose Unreal Engine world, gameplay and editor operations through MCP tools.
candidates.reason: High-authority engine mutation surface; test only against a disposable Unreal project copy before any Project Jennifer integration.

candidates.primitive: Persistent agent memory exposed through MCP/REST with graph-oriented retrieval and consolidation.
candidates.reason: Strong memory-spine candidate, but external memory remains subordinate to KPGS canonical receipts and replay truth.

candidates.primitive: Temporal graph+vector state with MVCC, graph traversal, vector retrieval, memory decay and MCP access.
candidates.reason: Useful temporal-state substrate; benchmark against the existing persistence layer before adoption.

candidates.primitive: Deterministic local-first knowledge graph and drift/guardrail layer with no LLM in the hot path.
candidates.reason: Coding-agent oriented upstream; adapt the deterministic truth-gate pattern rather than assuming its domain model fits NPCs directly.

candidates.primitive: Local speech-to-text and text-to-speech exposed as a small MCP voice interface.
candidates.reason: Small bounded voice surface makes it suitable for an isolated I/O experiment before character voice identity work.

candidates.primitive: Dual-process personality-consistency architecture for LLM role-playing agents.
candidates.reason: Strong NPC-mind research candidate; personality signals must remain gameplay constructs rather than clinical claims about real people.

candidates.primitive: Unity NPC/agent runtime with tool calling, persistent memory, local/cloud model routing and guarded runtime actions.
candidates.reason: Excellent executable reference implementation, but current licence is non-commercial; no commercial Kopano code reuse without separate permission/licence.
Use as an evaluation reference/harness; it is not the authoritative NPC runtime.
